name: Vision Plastics Inc.
old_description: At Vision Plastics, we are more than an injection molding company. We are a plastic manufacturing partner who offers a full range of molding services.
about:
Vision Plastics Inc. is headquartered in Wilsonville, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The company operates as a full-service plastic injection molder with approximately 200 employees. Its capabilities span custom injection molding, clean-room molding, insert molding, and a range of secondary operations including heat staking, ultrasonic welding, automated mechanical and electronic assembly, and coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology. Vision Plastics also provides in-house engineering support such as design for manufacturing (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), mold flow analysis, and custom end-of-arm tooling and fixturing. Part sizes range from less than one gram to over 3,800 grams (8.5 lbs).

Vision Plastics serves original equipment manufacturers in healthcare, electronics, information technology, consumer products, and industrial equipment markets. The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer-focused approach and offers flexible manufacturing models to adapt to product changes over time.

The company differentiates itself through its people and culture, combining state-of-the-art machinery with lean manufacturing methods to reduce waste and improve efficiency. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification through TUV Rheinland and AS9100 certification, and aims for zero defects per million (DPM) through continuous improvement.
